title: Primary living space on an upper floor has direct access to open space sized per Table 2.1a
text: C2.1.1 Each dwelling is to have one room that is the designated primary living space where: ii. the primary living space is provided on an upper floor, it is to have direct physical and visual access to a private open space (such as a balcony or rooftop terrace) in accordance with Table 2.1a.

parts.label: minimum dimension 2 m (studio/1 bed) or 2.4 m (2+ bed) per Table 2.1a

replaces.note: balcony sizes moved from Table 1.1b to Table 2.1a

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Table 2.1a minimum dimension column (2 m / 2.4 m) is encoded in the evaluator. Rows '2+ bedroom 10m2' and '3 or more bedrooms 12m2' overlap; the table encodes 2 bedrooms = 10m2 and 3+ = 12m2 (current Table 1.1b reading). Register ch3-020: an upstairs-living dwelling at R25 and below cannot meet both this and the C1.1.1 OLA access test unless a balcony counts as OLA; two merit clauses are numbered M2.1.2.

verified.note: Values match p15 (8m2 / 10m2 / 12m2; 2m / 2.4m). Ambiguous on the page: Table 2.1a rows '2+ bedroom' (10m2) and '3 or more bedrooms' (12m2) overlap; the 2.4m dimension cell spans both rows. Same density-scope question as C2.1.1(i).
